style.view: orthogonal three-quarter overhead JRPG, not isometric
style.palette: muted moss and olive, weathered warm timber, cool slate, restrained amber accents
style.lighting: upper-left; no large baked ground shadow
rules: real alpha for isolated props; opaque full coverage for terrain
no generated text or checkerboard backgrounds
preserve accepted originals and ground-contact origins
LPC stays the production animation source
declared canvas sizes are review targets, not mandatory distortion dimensions

audioDirection.motif: original three-note ward motif; lock an accepted reference before expansion
audioDirection.mixTargets: music -18 LUFS-I ±2; ambience -24 LUFS-I ±3; peak ≤-1 dBTP; short SFX category-calibrated
audioDirection.note: Targets are project choices. Requested duration/BPM/key are not measured facts. Ward ending stingers are deferred until authoritative story completion.

jobs.subject: One old stone village well seen from above and slightly behind: a round mortared fieldstone drum with a timber crossbeam and a rope wound on the windlass, moss at the foot. The whole object must sit on ONE centred footprint — no separate bucket, tool or stone lying beside it. Warm muted woodland-fantasy palette, soft upper-left light, crisp readable silhouette at native game scale, hand-painted pixel-friendly rendering. Render the object isolated and centred on a completely flat solid pure black background that fills every edge; no ground plane, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow on the background, no lettering, no border. The object must sit on ONE centred footprint and occupy roughly the middle 55% of the frame, centred, with generous empty black background margin on all four sides — the object must never touch or cross the edge of the image, and its lowest point must be directly below its centre of mass so it stands on one centred footprint.

notes: Rebased onto the pack 5.0.0 baseline by scripts/src/lib/ops/rebase_emberwatch_brief.ts; the exact source revision is recorded in baseline.commit.

The audio lane is deliberately out of scope for this release: no shipped local SFX/ambience model exists (stable_audio_open_1_0_profile is declared but not installed) and the pack-local Emberwatch music is already accepted.

Every prop job renders on a flat dark ground so prop-full-alpha-ground can derive true alpha deterministically; an opaque light-ground render cannot be separated without a colour key, which is not an approved removal.
Enemy visual jobs produce authored non-humanoid art for ash_hound, cinder_thrall and ember_warden; they replace the placeholder humanoid LPC bodies.
